name: 42-24 Cambridge Data Centre
notes: 42-24 says its data centres are located in Derwent Park and Cambridge; Data Center Map and PeeringDB list the Cambridge facility at 67 Kennedy Dr, Cambridge TAS 7170, within Clarence.

name: Firmus Project Southgate Wesley Vale AI Factory
notes: Regional north-west Tasmania activity recorded against Devonport because sources describe Wesley Vale as east/near Devonport; ABC says a development application was submitted and Latrobe Council was awaiting more information before public release, so the site is outside Devonport City Council jurisdiction.

name: Firmus Project Southgate Bell Bay / Long Reach AI Factory
notes: Firmus FAQ identifies Lot 1 East Tamar Highway, Long Reach on the former Gunns Pulp Mill site at Bell Bay and says the site will draw approximately 288 MW. Pulse reported the George Town Council application and described the capacity as about 300 MW.

name: DXN / TAS01 Tasmania One Data Centre
notes: Facility at 40-50 Innovation Drive, Dowsing Point, in the Glenorchy LGA. DCD reported DXN acquired it from TasmaNet in 2020 and sold the Hobart/TAS01 colocation business to DADT in 2026; rack count/power varies by source, so capacity is left null.

name: 42-24 Derwent Park Data Centre
notes: 42-24 says it operates data centres in Derwent Park and Cambridge; Data Center Map and ColoMap list the Derwent Park/Moonah facility at 104 Gormanston Rd, within Glenorchy.

name: TasmaNet DC1
notes: Listed colocation facility at Level 9, 1 Franklin Wharf, Hobart TAS 7000; Data Center Map specs identify cabinet, cage, suite and remote-hands services but no power capacity.

name: Vocus Data Centre - Hobart
notes: Listed colocation facility at Level 2/29 Elizabeth St, Hobart TAS 7000. Data Center Map notes PIPE Networks Hobart became part of Vocus after the PIPE Networks transaction finalized on 31 July 2025.
